passage: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities as of June 30, 2026, were $849.5 million as compared to $646.0 million as of December 31, 2025.
unsupported_pairings: June 30, 2026 or December 31, 2025 proposed as an event date — they are balance-sheet snapshot dates inside a past financial statement
a cash-balance 'event' — a financial figure at a date is not a calendar catalyst
review_reason: Two printed dates sit inside a statement of past financial position; neither is an event. This is the real-page counterpart of the reporting-period-end rule: nearby dates that belong to a snapshot, not to any development.
